steps.title: Open the cockpit
steps.narration: Let's start at Tapeology's home page — the live cockpit where a trader watches a ticker's tape in real time.
steps.point_out: The Live / Historical / Simulated toggle at the top, and a friendly empty state waiting for a ticker to watch.

steps.title: Choose a ticker to watch
steps.narration: Type in a ticker to watch — here, the app's own built-in simulated ticker, SIM-BUYER, which needs no real market data or credentials.
steps.point_out: The ticker field now reads SIM-BUYER.

steps.title: Watch the live tape
steps.narration: Click Watch, and the cockpit springs to life with a full set of live tape-reading panels.
steps.point_out: Six live panels appear — Tape State, Quote, Recent Trades, Features, Observations, and Event Log — with a feed badge confirming the data source.

steps.title: Open Structure
steps.narration: Now let's look at the Structure page, where Tapeology maps out a stock's key support-and-resistance price levels.
steps.point_out: A Symbol and As-of form, plus a Registry panel naming the reigning Champion trading strategy.

expect.text: Choose a symbol and an as-of time, then Load, to see its S/R levels and confluence zones.

steps.title: Pick a symbol
steps.narration: Enter a real stock symbol — AAPL — to pull up its price structure.
steps.point_out: The Symbol field now reads AAPL.

steps.title: Set the as-of time
steps.narration: Set the as-of time so the chart shows exactly what was known at that moment.
steps.point_out: The As-of field is filled in and ready to load.

steps.title: Load the price structure
steps.narration: Click Load, and the chart renders that symbol's real price history with support-and-resistance levels drawn on top.
steps.point_out: A full candlestick chart appears with level lines, plus a row of confluence zone cards below showing where several levels cluster together.

expect.text: Candles: 1d series (24 of 24 recorded bars, as of the query time). Level lines span every recorded timeframe.

steps.title: Open the Journal
steps.narration: Next, the Journal — where every trade idea gets logged and later graded against what the tape actually did.
steps.point_out: A table of past theses, each tagged with its data feed and outcome.

steps.title: Review a trade idea
steps.narration: Click into a thesis to see its full review — what was expected, what actually happened, and how it graded.
steps.point_out: The review page breaks down entry risk, execution checks, and the tape's verdict timeline for this trade.

steps.title: Open Studies
steps.narration: Over on Studies, you can replay past trade setups against historical data to see how a strategy would have performed.
steps.point_out: A study-creation form on the left, and a results panel on the right ready to show whatever you select.

expect.text: Create a study, or select one from the list, to read its results.

steps.title: Watch the study form respond live
steps.narration: Switch the study's data source to a seeded simulation, and a scenario picker appears live — every field in the form responds instantly.
steps.point_out: A new "Sim scenario" dropdown shows up with options like SIM-REVERSAL and SIM-BUYER.

steps.title: Open Performance
steps.narration: Finally, Performance — an honest scorecard of how each strategy has actually done, including on data it's never seen before.
steps.point_out: A PnL ledger on the left, and the current Champion strategy summary on the right.

steps.title: A broken link stays graceful
steps.narration: Even a broken link stays graceful — if a thesis doesn't exist, the Journal shows a clear message instead of a blank screen or a crash.
steps.point_out: A clear notice appears, with a link straight back to the Journal.
